mouse CLICK entry is canonical (sets follow_tail) but keyboard Enter is not — input-modality divergence on the same transition
multi-KB mission-brief paste fails in the forwarder — 'Paste failed' written to the invisible channel; operator assumes the brief landed
git status present for the selected session permanently occupies the slot — even off-Sessions messages written during a Sessions render window are lost on tab return
systemd restarts the rmux daemon after a crash: all sessions survive (daemon re-attach) but every open TUI is permanently blind until manual Ctrl+R
daemon dies BEFORE first connect_cached success: get_or_try_init retries and recovers — only the post-success death is unrecoverable (asymmetry worth a test)
